title.en: MALACANANG . BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES 125 EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. REVITALIZING THE NATIONAL INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY (NITC) AND THE NATIONAL the National Information Technology Plan for the 21 st or IT21 envisions the Philippines to become a Knowledge Center in Asia by the first decade of the 21st Century; to realize this vision there is need to leverage the competitive advantage and further build on the momentum over the past years on harnessing and exploiting potentials of information technology (IT) as a strategic development strategy for greater productivity and economic growth; there is an urgent need to strengthen the institutional to effectively mobilize and coordinate the individual collective resources and talents of all sectors concerned in the pursuit of this vision; the National Information Technology Council (NITC) , created pursuant to Executive Order No. 190, dated 19 July 1994, and reorganized pursuant to Executive Order No. 469, dated 23 February 1998, as the highest planning and policy advisory body on IT matters, needs a dynamic and effective executive agency to meet its support services requirements in the performance of its functions; the National Center (NCC), which created pursuant to EO No. 322 (s. 1971), as amended by PD No. 1480
